name: Postgres Database
rationale: Postgres-backed apps need explicit schema, migration, and repository ownership so UI and route files do not become data-access dumping grounds.

sources.label: Postgres repository and migration discipline
sources.note: Rules focus on separating UI, server-only query modules, schema, and migrations.

fileRules.name: No UI queries
fileRules.rule: UI modules must not construct SQL or call database clients directly.
fileRules.trigger: A TSX/component file imports database clients or contains SQL fragments.
fileRules.recommendation: Move database access into repositories or server-only modules.
fileRules.goodExample: Component receives data from a server module via props.
fileRules.badExample: Component imports db and calls db.select().

fileRules.name: Migration discipline
fileRules.rule: Schema changes should include a migration and a brief rationale.
fileRules.trigger: Schema files change without a migration file.
fileRules.recommendation: Add a versioned migration and document why the schema changed.
fileRules.badExample: Schema type changes with no migration.

moduleBoundaries: Database access should be isolated behind repositories or server-only query modules.
Migrations are append-only unless the project is explicitly pre-production.
testingExpectations: Important queries should have repository-level tests or integration coverage.
agentInstructions: Never hide database calls inside React components or route composition files.
